endorsements.name: Harrison Healey
endorsements.label: CVE-2023-1775
endorsements.description: When running in a High Availability configuration, Mattermost fails to sanitize some of the user_updated and post_deleted events broadcast to all users, leading to disclosure of sensitive information to some of the users with currently connected Websocket clients.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 4.3)

povs-taxonomy.explanation: The CVE endorsement credits this individual with a reviewed vulnerability finding.

endorsements.name: Harrison Healey
endorsements.label: CVE-2023-35075
endorsements.description: Mattermost fails to use  innerText / textContent when setting the channel name in the webapp during autocomplete, allowing an attacker to inject HTML to a victim's page by create a channel name that is valid HTML. No XSS is possible though.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: LOW (CVSS 3.1, 3.1)

povs-taxonomy.explanation: The CVE endorsement credits this individual with a reviewed vulnerability finding.

endorsements.name: Harrison Healey
endorsements.label: CVE-2023-43754
endorsements.description: Mattermost fails to check whether the  “Allow users to view archived channels”  setting is enabled during permalink previews display, allowing members to view permalink previews of archived channels even if the “Allow users to view archived channels” setting is disabled.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 4.3)

endorsements.name: Harrison Healey
endorsements.label: CVE-2024-39807
endorsements.description: Mattermost versions 9.5.x <= 9.5.5 and 9.8.0 fail to properly sanitize the recipients of a webhook event which allows an attacker monitoring webhook events to retrieve the channel IDs of archived or restored channels.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: LOW (CVSS 3.1, 3.1)

endorsements.name: Harrison Healey
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-14350
endorsements.description: Mattermost versions 11.1.x <= 11.1.2, 10.11.x <= 10.11.9, 11.2.x <= 11.2.1 fail to properly validate team membership when processing channel mentions which allows authenticated users to determine the existence of teams and their URL names via posting channel shortlinks and observing the channel_mentions property in the API response. Mattermost Advisory ID: MMSA-2025-00563
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 4.3)
